"On February 20, 2025, the journey of Pune’s most iconic township began, with blessings at Shreemant Dagdusheth Halwai Ganpati Mandir and a powerful vision unveiled. Hiranandani Communities and Krisala Developers came together to launch a 105-acre integrated township development at North Hinjawadi, Pune.
